# YatiSphere

> YatiSphere builds AI agents and workflows for law firms, banks, insurers and B2B SaaS companies: agents do the repetitive work, people approve what matters, and every step is logged. Work is done in the client's own infrastructure on AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud, together with the cloud, data and controls the agents need. Engagements start with a fixed-fee Solution Blueprint (two to four weeks).

YatiSphere Technologies Private Limited is registered in Noida, India (CIN U62013UP2025PTC239315) and works with clients worldwide, with a focus on the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, the Middle East and India. Contact: sales@yatisphere.com or https://yatisphere.com/contact-us.

## Services

- [Applied AI](https://yatisphere.com/what-we-do/applied-ai): take an AI pilot into production with evaluation, human approval, audit trails and integration. Model- and cloud-neutral.
- [Claude implementation](https://yatisphere.com/what-we-do/applied-ai/claude): Claude enterprise adoption, Claude Code rollout, agents and MCP integrations on the Anthropic API, Amazon Bedrock, Vertex AI or Microsoft Foundry.
- [AI agents for document-heavy workflows](https://yatisphere.com/what-we-do/applied-ai/agentic-automation): intake, KYC and claims agents and knowledge assistants with citations.
- [Local AI](https://yatisphere.com/what-we-do/applied-ai/local-ai): open-weight LLMs and AI agents run on the client's own servers, private cloud or fully disconnected sites, with hybrid routing to cloud models for less sensitive work.
- [AI governance](https://yatisphere.com/what-we-do/applied-ai/ai-governance): alignment to the NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and EU AI Act risk tiers.
- [AI-assisted engineering](https://yatisphere.com/what-we-do/applied-ai/ai-assisted-engineering): coding-assistant rollout with guardrails and measurement.
- [Cloud foundations](https://yatisphere.com/what-we-do/cloud): landing zones, FinOps, managed operations and disaster recovery on AWS and Azure, defined as code.
- [Cloud migration](https://yatisphere.com/what-we-do/cloud/migration): dependency mapping, wave planning and cutover with tested rollback.
- [Software, data and modernization](https://yatisphere.com/what-we-do/engineering-data): core software, data platforms, DevOps and legacy modernization.
- [Security and compliance](https://yatisphere.com/what-we-do/services/security-compliance): identity, data protection, detection and audit evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA and DORA.
- [Enterprise architecture review](https://yatisphere.com/what-we-do/consulting/enterprise-architecture): an independent review of the current estate and planned design, with ranked risks and a transition plan.
- [Solution Blueprint](https://yatisphere.com/blueprint): fixed-fee assessment that produces a solution design, delivery plan and risk register before any build.

## Industries

- [Financial services](https://yatisphere.com/what-we-do/industries/financial-services): KYC and onboarding automation, AML monitoring, post-trade and core modernization.
- [Legal and professional services](https://yatisphere.com/what-we-do/industries/legal-professional-services): client intake, conflict checks and practice-system integration.
- [Software and SaaS](https://yatisphere.com/what-we-do/industries/software-saas): enterprise security reviews, SOC 2 readiness and multi-tenant platforms.

## Insights

- [MCP governance: a technical guide to letting AI agents into your systems](https://yatisphere.com/insights/mcp-governance-for-regulated-firms): authorization, tool metadata, gateways and audit logging for MCP in regulated firms.
- [The anatomy of MCP](https://yatisphere.com/insights/anatomy-of-mcp): hosts, clients, servers, messages, transports, extensions and the registry, as of the 2026-07-28 specification.
- [MCP anti-patterns](https://yatisphere.com/insights/mcp-anti-patterns): fifteen mistakes in MCP tool design, security and operations, each tied to a real incident or measurement.
- [Kill switches, approvals and audit logs: a reference design for AI agents](https://yatisphere.com/insights/ai-agent-kill-switches-approvals-audit-logs): how to stop, approve and audit AI agents in production, mapped to the EU AI Act, OWASP and US bank supervisors' questions.
- [Enterprise AI governance: the operating model, controls and evidence that hold up](https://yatisphere.com/insights/enterprise-ai-governance-operating-model): who decides, the AI inventory, risk tiers, lifecycle gates, vendor AI, controls, assurance, board reporting and a twelve-month roadmap.
- [Your regulator is asking how you'd shut down your AI agents. SR 26-2 won't help you answer.](https://yatisphere.com/insights/sr-26-2-ai-agents-bank-supervisors): what US bank supervisors are asking about AI agents after SR 26-2, the OCC's November 2026 examiner framework, and how to build evidence-based answers.
- [Every AI agent needs an identity: access, delegation and least privilege](https://yatisphere.com/insights/ai-agent-identity-access-delegation): agent identities, on-behalf-of token exchange, workload identity, task-scoped and short-lived tokens, revocation, lifecycle, vendor OAuth grants and an access review checklist.
- [Testing AI agents before production: evals, red teaming and release gates](https://yatisphere.com/insights/testing-ai-agents-before-production): real task sets, graders, pass^k consistency, prompt injection and fault tests, budgets, release gates and production feedback.
- [Generative AI in a law firm: what ABA Formal Opinion 512 asks of you](https://yatisphere.com/insights/aba-opinion-512-generative-ai-law-firms)
- [Using the NIST AI RMF without a large compliance team](https://yatisphere.com/insights/nist-ai-rmf-for-mid-market-teams)
- [Taking an AI pilot to production in a regulated business](https://yatisphere.com/insights/taking-an-ai-pilot-to-production)
- [The EU AI Act for bank and insurance operations teams](https://yatisphere.com/insights/eu-ai-act-for-financial-services-operations)
- [KYC automation without black boxes](https://yatisphere.com/insights/kyc-automation-without-black-boxes)
- [SOC 2 evidence your delivery pipeline can produce](https://yatisphere.com/insights/soc-2-evidence-from-pipelines)
- [Azure OpenAI in UAE North: what data residency covers](https://yatisphere.com/insights/azure-openai-uae-north-data-residency)
- [Azure FinOps quick wins, ordered by effort](https://yatisphere.com/insights/azure-finops-quick-wins)
